answer: Make every agent stake a deposit behind an identity cipher to trade: the cipher is a public-key proof tying one account to one costly credential, so minting a thousand fake agents means paying a thousand deposits. A bridge service cross-checks each cipher against other registries to catch duplicates, while reputation grows slowly, like a juniper, through completed work and is lost instantly on fraud, so a stake is worth more alive than burned. An attacker must fund every fake identity and wait months to look trustworthy, and one exposed forgery wipes them, turning sybils into a bad investment.
